```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style for seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a figure and axis
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of Sleep Duration across different BMI Categories
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', palette='Set2')

# Add title and labels
plt.title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')

# Add a legend
plt.legend(title='Gender')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
